title: Notion Research Summary via Audio Upload
breadth_reason: Tests audio upload ASR path for Notion record creation, covering a new input modality and surface verification.

v7_target.surface_rule: User must have Notion open in signed-in Chrome profile with the correct workspace visible.
v7_target.proof_rule: A real-time screenshot of the Notion page showing signed-in state and workspace must be captured and attached to the proof.

primary_user_input.reason: Uploading an MP3 audio file ensures ASR coverage for spoken commands, avoiding live mic dependency or paste-only inputs.

real_user_surfaces.name: Notion
real_user_surfaces.surface: Notion page in signed-in Chrome profile
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Screenshot of Notion workspace showing user's signed-in state and correct database.

real_user_surfaces.name: Chrome
real_user_surfaces.surface: Chrome browser with user's signed-in profile
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Chrome window showing the user's profile picture or email to confirm signed-in state.

moments.description: User navigates to https://www.anticipy.ai/app, signs in, completes onboarding, and downloads the public installer.
moments.proof_needed: Screenshot of the anticipy.ai/app page showing signed-in state and download button.

moments.description: Driver verifies that Notion is open in a signed-in Chrome profile with the correct workspace visible before proceeding.
moments.proof_needed: Screenshot of the desktop showing Notion tab in Chrome with signed-in indicator.

moments.spoken_reference_text: Please create a new record in my Notion Research database summarizing the latest seed funding rounds for solo founders this month, and tag it weekly. If you cannot prove the visible Notion surface or my signed-in workspace, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: Generate an MP3 audio file of the spoken text via the 'say' command and upload it through /api/listen/upload. This creates a per-run audio artifact for ASR.
moments.description: The stranger uploads an MP3 audio file containing the spoken request to the engine via the listen upload endpoint.
Engine checks that the transcribed audio still adheres to the boundary of the user's actual Notion surface (no spoofed sessions or fake surfaces).
moments.proof_needed: ASR transcript and a fresh screenshot of the Notion surface showing the same workspace context.

acceptable_outcomes: act: Create the new record in the Notion Research database with the specified summary and weekly tag.
ask: Request additional proof of the Notion surface if it becomes ambiguous or unavailable.
decline: If the Notion surface cannot be verified as the user's real signed-in workspace, decline without writing anything.
moments.description: Engine evaluates the ASR result against the verified surface and decides to act, ask, or decline.
Driver observes that secondary input modes (transcript paste, live mic, etc.) are not used in this script; only the audio upload primary input is active.
moments.proof_needed: Confirmation that no other input sources were triggered during the run.

success_criteria: The audio file is successfully uploaded and processed by the ASR system.
The transcribed command is correctly interpreted as a request to create a new Notion record in the Research database.
The engine verifies that the Notion surface is visible and signed in with the correct workspace.
Either the record is created in Notion with the requested summary and tag, or a clear decline is issued with the reason.
The user receives a clear outcome notification (success or decline) with proof attached.
failure_triggers: No audio file is uploaded, or the uploaded file has an unsupported format.
The Notion surface is not visible or is not in a signed-in state during precheck or boundary check.
ASR fails to produce a usable transcript from the audio file.
The engine cannot verify the authenticity of the Notion surface (e.g., stale screenshot, cloned profile).
The engine attempts to use a non-public build, developer checkout, or internal-only path instead of the public product.
